name: Slack
description: Slack is a workplace communication platform built around channels, direct messages, integrations, and searchable conversations.
best_for: Positioned for teams and businesses across departments — engineering, sales, customer service, marketing, HR — looking to replace email-based workflows with organized, searchable communication.

alternatives.name: Microsoft Teams
alternatives.description: A communication and collaboration platform with chat, meetings, file sharing, and Microsoft 365 integration.

alternatives.name: Discord
alternatives.description: A community-focused communication platform with text channels, voice rooms, and real-time collaboration.

alternatives.name: Mattermost
alternatives.description: A team messaging platform designed for organizations that need greater control over hosting and security.

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Message and file history limited to 90 days; up to 10 app/service integrations; 1:1 huddles only; basic AI features (Slackbot, search, summaries). Billing basis: n/a.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: $8.75/user/month if billed monthly instead of annually (~20% premium). Unlimited message history, unlimited app integrations, group huddles, Slack Connect with external orgs. Billing basis: monthly (billed annually).

tiers.name: Business+
tiers.notes: $18/user/month if billed monthly (~20% premium). Adds SAML-based SSO, SCIM provisioning, custom retention/compliance exports, 24/7 support with 4-hour response SLA. Pricing/features updated June 2025 (effective at first renewal after 2025-08-17); the standalone Slack AI add-on was discontinued and folded into this tier. Billing basis: monthly (billed annually).

tiers.name: Enterprise+
tiers.notes: No public per-seat price; fully custom quote. Adds unlimited workspaces, org-wide SCIM/SSO, data residency, legal holds, information barriers, enterprise-grade AI/search. Billing basis: custom.

cons: The Free plan's message and file history is capped at 90 days of visibility (confirmed on Slack's own pricing page), not the older 10,000-message cap some legacy free workspaces had — older content becomes inaccessible after 90 days unless you upgrade to a paid plan.

Basic identity/security controls that many mid-size orgs need — SAML-based single sign-on and SCIM user provisioning — are gated behind the Business+ tier ($15/user/month billed annually, $18/user/month billed monthly), which is roughly double the Pro plan's price ($7.25/$8.75 per user/month); there is no self-serve tier between Pro and Business+ for SSO.

In a June 2025 pricing/packaging overhaul, Slack discontinued the standalone Slack AI add-on for new purchases and raised Business+ pricing to fold AI features into that tier; existing standalone-AI-add-on customers keep access only until their first renewal after August 17, 2025, after which they must move to a paid plan that bundles it (per Slack's own help-center announcement).
